purpose: Single source of truth for PKM reload tail repairs. import_audio.py reads this and imports the repaired WAV for any asset listed here, so re-running the committed restore entry can no longer silently revert a repaired SoundWave to the raw video cut.
warning: The base cuts in audio_manifest.json still contain the reference video's background music bed. They are inputs to the repair recipes, not deliverables. Do not import them over the assets listed below.
source: BV1jHeA6sEmj user-selected reference video; derivatives local only, redistribution rights not established.
regenerate: BeltAudio22/apply_tail_repair.py -- then import_audio.py (or the round's _import_*_ue.py) to install the results.

active_recipe.why_v2: The 2026-09-25 route and the first 2026-09-28 attempt both colour-matched the replacement to the music bed's own spectrum and then envelope-matched it to the bed's level, so the 'music-free' tail was a resynthesis of the bed. The user still heard BGM. v2 keeps the donor's own mechanical colour, applies a 1000 Hz highpass to the donor only, and gives the tail a synthetic decay that falls 30 dB below the bed instead of holding the bed's level.
active_recipe.measured_suppression_note: suppression_db is measured in the bed's own band (250-1000 Hz, where 78 % of the reload bed and 90 % of the charge bed sits), old tail vs new tail.

repairs.note: Supersedes the 2026-09-25 rebuild, which shared the bed-resynthesis flaw.
Lowest suppression of the set: this clip's own peak is only 24 dB above the bed, so the tail starts near the bed and has the most to lose. Also covers the mid-clip music hole at 267-341 ms.
Skipped in the v1 round as too short; v2's synthetic decay has no envelope-ratio degeneracy, so short tails are safe.
Supersedes the 2026-09-25 rebuild, which shared the bed-resynthesis flaw.
Also plays as the PKM equip pull (FPSGAMECharacter.cpp L2565). Its energy is almost all below 1 kHz, so a highpass on the asset was rejected (5.4 dB peak loss); filtering only the donor avoids that.
Skipped in the v1 round; v2 handles it.

measured_and_left_alone.reason: The delivered asset is padded with digital silence after 245.3 ms, so the trailing 94.7 ms carries no music at all. Verified in the time domain (max |x| = 0). Left byte-identical.

not_a_repair_candidate.reason: Dead asset. No code path references it: PKM reload cues use ReloadSoundPath for the six mechanical contacts, and PKM charge cues use ChargeSoundPath -> ChargeAudio35 (FPSGAMECharacter.cpp L1124-1127, L2565). It still carries the bed but is never played.

donor.measured_with: 80 Hz highpass applied, matching the authoring chain
donor.why_not_the_20260925_donor: 25.010-25.215 s was chosen from a margin measured WITHOUT the authoring highpass. With the highpass its minimum falls to -2.3 dB and 96-139 ms sits at 2.5-5.1 dB, so a 130-224 ms tail rebuilt from it copies the music back in.
